dylan.songTitle: A Simple Desultory Philippic (Or How I Was Robert McNamara’d into Submission)
dylan.line: He doesn't dig poetry, he's so unhip when you say Dylan
stanza: I knew a man, his brain so small
He couldn't think of nothing at all
Not the same as you and me
He doesn't dig poetry, he's so unhip when you say Dylan
He thinks you're talking about Dylan Thomas, whoever he was
The man ain't got no culture
But it's alright, Ma! Everybody must get stoned

dylan.line: I play Bobby Dylan, a young Bobby Dylan
stanza: As a matter of fact, this song is so cinematic
That it's been made into a movie directed by Otto Preminger
It stars Senator Carl Hayden as Ho Chi Minh
Frank Sinatra plays Fidel Castro
Ronald Reagan plays George Murphy
John Wayne plays Lyndon Johnson
And Lyndon Johnson plays God
I play Bobby Dylan, a young Bobby Dylan
Scotch and penicillin
Please try Carlton
A cold black maple hangar
And husbands on the run

trilon.line: Here is Grover Whalen unveilin' the Trilon
stanza: Here is Grover Whalen unveilin' the Trilon
Over on the West Coast we have Treasure Island
Here's Najinsky a-doin' the rhumba
Here's her social security numba

villain.line: It's a word! No, a name! MF the Super-Villain!
villain.linePrev: What the Devil? He's on another level
And tell him give me space, I don't know that nigga (Nigga)
villain.lineNext: Whole van tinted (Tinted), nope, can't kill him (No)
